metadata.description: Seed-coupled comparison on Qwen3-8B of temperature (NO-PN block) vs plan noise (isotropic directions at task-spec states, blocks 12-23, prefill only) for T2/T1/T03; thinking-on T2 under vLLM per-request seeds.

couplings.gumbel: HF exponential race = Gumbel-max (per-row CUDA generator)

within_seed_permutation_test.note: assumption-light robustness check of H-CON: condition labels permuted within seed (exchangeability null); not the committed test

placebo_condition_permutation.note: condition labels shuffled within seed; p should be ~uniform

repeat_T0.7.note: the temperature change count is read against this noise floor

within_seed_permutation_test.note: assumption-light robustness check of H-CON: condition labels permuted within seed (exchangeability null); not the committed test

placebo_condition_permutation.note: condition labels shuffled within seed; p should be ~uniform

iii_gumbel.coupling: HF exponential race = Gumbel-max (per-row CUDA generator)

causal_mask_check.note: exact 0 requires identical GEMM shapes; FP8 prefill of different lengths may differ

repeat_T0.7.note: the temperature change count is read against this noise floor
the temperature change count is read against this noise floor

fp8_crosscheck.note: bf16 HF does not fit the 16 GB card: the cross-check compares the two FP8 implementations (vLLM weight-only Marlin vs HF W8A8); exp18 bounded FP8 vs bf16 on T2 (JS 0.033 bits, null p95 0.068). The cell is near 100% Dijkstra, so this is a weak precision check.

u6_vllm.note: exactness across batch compositions is not guaranteed below CC 9.0 (no batch invariance on Ada); U6c confirms the step-indexed exponential-race coupling on this build when the match rate is ~1 (a mismatch is possible only when the winner lies outside the returned top-20, tail mass given)

4_screen_headlines.note: rule A (excess only) gives T2 5/15: reported as a mismatch of that reading; rule B (excess and pass ratio >= 0.85) reproduces both counts

expectations.method: 20,000 MC reps; 6 directions with replacement from the task's screen directions; p_d = max(0, excess); landing labels from each direction's off-default distribution; NOPN off-default w.p. the twin share

T03_a1.0_unit_adjusted_linear_dose.note: p_d scaled by 1/ratio (alpha 1 here ~ alpha 1/ratio at the screen's unit; linear dose)

T03_a1.0_exp13_protocol_unit_pool.note: pool = exp13 rand1-3 (bf16, protocol-v4 unit, alpha 1), 3 directions

temperature.source: exp12 same-seed CRN: 0/30 seeds changed in 10 of 12 cells (rate 1/30 used as the stated prior)

expectations.note: No design change follows: more directions only shrink the lottery variance, they do not raise E[C_PN]. The T03 rows are optimistic: the screen used exp17's T03 unit, ~1.32x the protocol-v4 unit used here.

novelty_audit.manual_pass: each row carries its AST-nearest known solution (Jaccard of identifier-normalised 4-gram shingles) for the executor's manual read

first_approach_judge_audit.kappa_note: undefined (NaN) when both raters give a single label to every trace (chance agreement 1)

how_used.leetcodedataset/mercury/thealgorithms_py: known-solution pool for the A9 nearest-known-solution pass (LeetCode 743 = T2, 215 = T03, 1091 = T1-related)
how_used.llm_creativity: external reference composition of T02 (= T2) labels from another LLM study
how_used.concreteness_norms: provenance of the neutral twin noun 'man' used in every twin prompt
how_used.clrs_text/humanevalplus/enamel: not applicable here (tracer tests / harness validation / efficiency references for other tasks); loaded and counted only

deviations.what: Hardware: one 16 GB NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada (CC 8.9), not the 20 GB A4500 the budget assumed. Per the plan's S0/F2 branch for a 16 GB Ada card, the HF engine is exp17's FP8 W8A8 loader (the screen's own precision and card), not bf16.
deviations.consequence: precision equals the screen's; bf16-specific statements are not made

deviations.what: vLLM ran Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 with weight-only FP8 Marlin kernels, eager, torch.compile off (no C compiler on the machine, as in exp18).
deviations.consequence: the thinking-on arm and the HF arms use different FP8 implementations; A8 bounds the difference on one cell

deviations.what: The screen's escape rule ('N=10 rule') is not defined on the run volume; reconstructed as excess >= 0.20 and pass ratio >= 0.85 on the k 0-9 slots (reproduces T03 7/15, T2 3/15; excess-only reading gives T2 5/15, reported).

T03 unit: exp17's FP8 T03 norms are 1.32x (median) the protocol-v4 unit (exp13) used in the 2x2; alpha 1 on T03 is therefore a weaker push than the screen's alpha 1 (the engine check uses exp17's unit).
deviations.consequence: the committed T03 power expectation is optimistic; a unit-adjusted sensitivity is in results/expectations.json

deviations.what: Unit sensitivity recomputed on the FP8 W8A8 engine (bf16 does not fit the card), results/unit_sensitivity.json.
The first vLLM launch was stopped by this artifact's RAM watchdog, which counted page cache; fixed to working set (usage - inactive file) before any decisive sample; only engine load was lost.
OpenRouter GET /key returns 403 through the proxy; spend is tracked from usage.cost (results/costs.json, judge cost files).
A8 FP8 cross-check compares vLLM FP8 (Marlin) with HF FP8 W8A8 (bf16 HF cannot load on 16 GB); exp18's FP8-vs-bf16 bound on T2 is cited.
Figures rendered with matplotlib directly from the result dictionaries (not through the aii-data-fig-gen spec renderer).
Label 'disputed' (judge unavailable or over cap) is treated as 'unresolved' (excluded, with sensitivities).
Batch sizes per task decided by the committed rule: {'T2': 20, 'T03': 20, 'T1': 20, 'T2think': 10}.
deviations.consequence: constant within task across all arms

deviations.what: Drop decisions applied: none from the extrapolation; optional arm (i) (T1 thinking on, ~1.5 h) not run: less than 1.5 h of wall clock remained after G2.
deviations.consequence: T1 thinking-on statements are not made

deviations.what: The plan's (ii) causal-masking identity (max |diff| = 0 between thinking-on and -off clean S states) cannot hold bit-exactly under FP8 prefill of different lengths; the measured difference is logged (results/tpn_causal_mask_check.json).
deviations.consequence: PN in (ii) is anchored to the thinking-on clean prefill

deviations.what: Two venvs (.venv_hf, .venv_vllm) instead of one 'uv run': the vLLM script is run with .venv_vllm/bin/python; every other stage with .venv_hf/bin/python method.py --stage.

not_run: optional arm (i): T1 thinking on (wall clock)
